summary.en: Familiar fingerprint, card-option and PIN door terminal. A practical starting point for an existing office system assessment.
summary.sw: Kifaa kinachofahamika cha alama za vidole, PIN na chaguo la kadi. Kinafaa kuanzia tathmini ya mfumo uliopo ofisini.

value.sw: Alama za vidole / PIN; kadi kwa toleo husika

compatibility.en: AC PUSH and TA PUSH firmware have different software paths. Verify the installed firmware before selecting attendance software.
compatibility.sw: Firmware ya AC PUSH na TA PUSH hutumia njia tofauti za programu. Hakiki toleo kabla ya kuchagua programu ya mahudhurio.

summary.en: A newer fingerprint/card/PIN terminal with a 4MP camera. For assessed office access and supported attendance configurations.
summary.sw: Kifaa kipya zaidi cha alama za vidole, kadi na PIN chenye kamera ya 4MP. Kwa milango ya ofisi na mahudhurio katika mpangilio unaooana.

compatibility.en: Confirm firmware, software and optional video/intercom service. Camera presence does not establish CCTV recording capability.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki firmware, programu na huduma ya hiari ya video/intercom. Kamera yake haimaanishi ni mfumo wa kurekodi CCTV.

summary.en: Facial recognition for everyday workplace arrivals, with fingerprint on the 4A variant. Choose the exact entry or standard version.
summary.sw: Utambuzi wa uso kwa wafanyakazi wanapoingia; 4A pia ina alama za vidole. Chagua toleo halisi la entry au standard.

value.sw: 4A: alama za vidole na uso; 4B: uso, bila alama za vidole

compatibility.en: AC PUSH, TA PUSH and BEST modes serve different platforms. Optional battery and capacities depend on the purchased configuration. Photo: 4A.
compatibility.sw: AC PUSH, TA PUSH na BEST hutegemea jukwaa. Betri ya hiari na uwezo hutegemea kifaa kilichoagizwa. Picha: 4A.

summary.en: Face-based entry with distinct fingerprint, RFID and QR variants. Suitable for assessed attendance or door-access installations.
summary.sw: Kuingia kwa utambuzi wa uso, pamoja na matoleo tofauti ya alama za vidole, RFID na QR. Kwa mahudhurio au udhibiti wa mlango uliotathminiwa.

value.en: RFID model omits fingerprint; QR needs the QR variant
value.sw: RFID haina alama za vidole; QR inahitaji toleo la QR

compatibility.en: Current ZAM230 family reference. Do not apply old same-name model capacities. Confirm firmware and AC PUSH/TA PUSH software compatibility. Photo: V5L.
compatibility.sw: Rejea ya familia ya ZAM230. Usitumie uwezo wa modeli za zamani zenye jina hilo. Hakiki firmware na programu ya AC PUSH/TA PUSH. Picha: V5L.

images.alt: InBio Pro Plus Series — ZKTeco manufacturer photograph

summary.en: Controller-based access for one, two or four doors, with compatible readers. The controller belongs in a protected location.
summary.sw: Udhibiti wa mlango mmoja, miwili au minne kwa readers zinazooana. Controller huwekwa sehemu iliyolindwa.

compatibility.en: Verify reader protocol, firmware, lock power and licensed CVAccess/CVSecurity support. Photo shows InBio460 Pro Plus, not the complete door kit.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki protocol ya reader, firmware, umeme wa kufuli na leseni ya CVAccess/CVSecurity. Picha ni InBio460 Pro Plus; si seti kamili ya mlango.

summary.en: Older InBio controllers remain relevant when maintaining or assessing an existing installation. Identify the board and software before ordering replacements.
summary.sw: Controllers za awali za InBio zina umuhimu katika matengenezo ya mifumo iliyopo. Tambua board na programu kabla ya kuagiza mbadala.

compatibility.en: Not interchangeable with Pro Plus by name alone. Assess supported software and firmware; do not install unsupported legacy software. Photo: InBio160.
compatibility.sw: Jina pekee halimaanishi inabadilishana na Pro Plus. Hakiki programu na firmware zinazoungwa mkono. Picha: InBio160.

images.alt: C3 Plus Series — ZKTeco manufacturer photograph

summary.en: Card-oriented multi-door control for offices and institutions using suitable readers and separately specified door hardware.
summary.sw: Udhibiti wa milango kwa kadi katika ofisi na taasisi, ukitumia readers zinazofaa na vifaa vya mlango vilivyoainishwa.

compatibility.en: Verify door count, reader format and software licence for the exact board. This is the Plus family, not the older C3. Photo: C3-400 Plus.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki milango, aina ya reader na leseni ya programu kwa board husika. Hii ni familia ya Plus, si C3 ya zamani. Picha: C3-400 Plus.

summary.en: Fingerprint, passcode and IC-card smart lock with ZSmart app management over compatible Wi-Fi. Check the door before selecting a lock.
summary.sw: Kufuli janja la alama za vidole, namba ya siri na kadi ya IC, likisimamiwa na ZSmart kupitia Wi-Fi inayooana. Kagua mlango kwanza.

compatibility.en: ZSmart / 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. Not automatically compatible with HLMS or hotel PMS. Confirm battery supply and emergency access procedure at handover.
compatibility.sw: ZSmart / Wi-Fi ya 2.4GHz. Haioani moja kwa moja na kila HLMS au PMS ya hoteli. Hakiki betri na namna ya kufungua dharura.

summary.en: Lever-handle smart lock for compatible wooden swing doors, with fingerprint, card, PIN, ZSmart app and mechanical-key access.
summary.sw: Kufuli lenye mpini kwa mlango wa mbao wa bawaba unaofaa; hufunguka kwa alama za vidole, kadi, PIN, ZSmart au ufunguo.

compatibility.en: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi; Bluetooth is for network configuration. Confirm mortise, handing, batteries and connectivity; do not assume hotel software support.
compatibility.sw: Wi-Fi ya 2.4GHz; Bluetooth ni kwa usanidi wa mtandao. Hakiki mortise, mwelekeo, betri na mtandao; usidhani inaunganishwa na programu yoyote ya hoteli.

summary.en: RFID hotel-room lock reference. Plan guest cards, reception encoder and the matching hotel lock management system together.
summary.sw: Rejea ya kufuli la RFID la chumba cha hoteli. Panga kadi za wageni, encoder ya mapokezi na programu inayoendana pamoja.

value.en: Lock + compatible encoder, cards and software
value.sw: Kufuli + encoder, kadi na programu zinazoendana

compatibility.en: Verify HLMS / SmartLock version, lock firmware and encoder compatibility. PMS integration needs a separately confirmed interface and licence.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki toleo la HLMS / SmartLock, firmware ya kufuli na encoder. PMS inahitaji kiunganishi na leseni vilivyothibitishwa.

images.alt: TS2000 Plus Series — ZKTeco manufacturer photograph

summary.en: Bidirectional tripod entrance control for assessed staff or institutional entrances. Include a separate accessible route in the entrance plan.
summary.sw: Turnstile ya mikono mitatu kwa udhibiti wa kuingia na kutoka kwa wafanyakazi au taasisi. Panga pia njia inayofikika kwa wenye uhitaji.

value.sw: Mkono unaoshuka; njia ya dharura itathminiwe

compatibility.en: Readers, controller and software are selected separately. Ticketing, gym subscriptions and visitor systems require an integration assessment.
compatibility.sw: Readers, controller na programu huchaguliwa kulingana na mfumo. Tiketi, usajili wa gym na wageni vinahitaji tathmini ya uunganishaji.

summary.en: A compact two-door controller, expandable only with the specified optional modules. Plan readers and the software path before ordering.
summary.sw: Controller ndogo ya milango miwili, inayopanuka kwa modules za hiari zilizoainishwa tu. Panga readers na programu kabla ya kuagiza.

value.en: Optional DM10 modules; up to 8 doors in supported configuration
value.sw: DM10 za hiari; hadi milango 8 kwa mpangilio unaokubalika

compatibility.en: RS485 readers; supported Wiegand readers need the specified WR485 bridge. Confirm exact software/version support.
compatibility.sw: Readers za RS485; Wiegand inayooana inahitaji WR485 iliyoainishwa. Hakiki programu na toleo husika.

summary.en: RFID reader family for a matching access controller. Reader, card technology and interface must agree.
summary.sw: Familia ya readers za RFID kwa controller inayolingana. Reader, aina ya kadi na interface lazima ziendane.

value.en: Card credential reader; separate controller required
value.sw: Reader ya kadi; controller tofauti inahitajika

compatibility.en: Confirm suffix, card frequency/format, output protocol and controller support. A reader alone is not a complete door-access system.
compatibility.sw: Hakiki suffix, frequency/format ya kadi, protocol na controller. Reader pekee si mfumo kamili wa mlango.
